title: The Root Shapes the Fruit: On the Persistence of Gender-Exclusive Harms in Aligned Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model output generations for negative regard and toxicity using prompts centered on gender disclosure from the TANGO dataset, and analyzing implicit reward signals (log-probability ratios) in DPO-aligned models to measure preference for stigmatizing versus non-stigmatizing texts about transgender, non-binary, and gender-diverse (TGNB) individuals using a subset of the WinoQueer dataset.
